references.text: Here is given the detailed instruction regarding the wave offering of the breast and the right thigh that the priest was to receive as his portion. This is the direct source of the commandment that Aaron performs in Leviticus 9:21.
The breast belongs to Aaron and his sons after it has been waved as a wave offering before the Lord's presence.
The right thigh shall be given to the priest as a gift from the peace offerings.
During the consecration of Aaron and his sons, Moses performed the wave offering with the breast and the thigh, as preparation for what Aaron himself was to do.
Moses confirms that the waved breast and the lifted thigh are to be eaten in a clean place by Aaron and his descendants, as an everlasting right.
The original instruction given to Moses concerning the wave offering at the consecration of the priests, which forms the basis for the ritual.
The wave offering of the breast and the heave offering of the thigh are mentioned in connection with the Nazirite vow, showing the broader use of this ritual.
The waved breast and the right thigh belong to the priest as a holy gift.
